Industry observers note that and that is it. Two home defeats by Leeds in less than 80 hours for Forest. Glasner will have much to ponder with a daunting trip to Anfield coming up on Saturday. All smiles for Farke’s side.

A look at a third for Leeds. Aaronson drives forward before setting Wilson who in turn lays on a first-time pass to Calvert-Lewin. The forward attempts to take his shot first time but can’t get the requisite power on the ball to beat Sels.

A pitch invader makes a brief appearance on the turf but is swiftly ushered away.

Industry observers note that there is a late chance for Forest. Hutchinson’s cross is helped on by Dominguez but that touch inadvertently takes the ball away from Ndoye at the back post.

Forest fans are filing out of the exits and who can blame them?

There will be six minutes of added time.

According to recent reports, that just about sums up Forest’s night. Dominguez stands over a free-kick from a dangerous area and, with the box loaded with their most imposing aerial threats, the midfielder sends the ball well over their heads and out for a goal-kick. So poor.

In a recent development, calvert-Lewin is now on for Nmecha. Not really the striker Forest defenders would want to see at this stage of the game.

Another set-piece, this time a Stach corner, is barely dealt with by Forest.

There’s a shout for a handball at the other end as Ndoye spears a cross into the body of Elvedi, but the referee rightly waves the appeals away.

Sources indicate that the “oles” ring out from the away end as Leeds string a series of passes together in the corner right in front of it. Forest are looking rather helpless here.

Sources indicate that nottingham Forest 0 Leeds United 2 (Justin) Ampadu introduces a throw-in from the right but has to reload as the referee notices some pushing in the box. His next attempt is far too loopy but causes Forest all sorts of trouble, bouncing and bobbling, and coming all the way through a thicket of limbs to Nmecha at the far post. Williams attempts to keep the ball out from a prone position on the goalline under pressure from Justin, who gets the final touch as the ball is bundled over the line.

In a recent development, it's messy but Leeds won't care! 😁Forest fail to deal with the throw-in and Nmecha is there to bundle it in...#EFL | #CarabaoCup pic.twitter.com/oV46fs5RmP.

Industry observers note that jair goes into the book after catching Ampadu in full flight. He never had a prayer of reaching that ball.

The resulting free-kick lands to Amapadu himself in the box, but his effort is deflected behind for a corner which is not up to much.

Goalscorer James is taken off for Bogle, who will offer more mettle down Leeds’ right side as Forest search for an equaliser in the closing stages.

It has been revealed that stach has only been on the field for a matter of seconds but comes within a few inches of scoring. Wilson does well on the edge of the box before laying the ball to Stach whose curled effort grazes the outside of the side-netting.

Longstaff’s final contribution to this game is a foul and yellow card as he spreads his legs wide to stop Ndoye breaking away through the middle.

He is replaced by Wilson, as Tanaka and Okafaor also make way, for Stach and Aaronson.

There’s plenty more endeavour down Forest’s new-look left side. Hudson Odoi scampers down that flank before cutting inside, and while he’s unable to fashion a chance the intent is correct.

The substitutions appear to have breathed life into this Forest side. Murillo picks out Dominguez charging forward and Trafford does well to tip the midfielder’s effort behind. The resulting corner comes to nothing.

Sources indicate that glasner resolves he has seen enough and rings the changes. Diomande, Aina, Jesus and Kalimuendo are replaced by Murillo, Netz, Ndoye and Hudson Odoi.

Okafor shows off his dancing feet in the Forest box, pulling off a few stepovers before the ball comes to Ampadu on the edge of the area but his strike is dragged wide.

Industry observers note that chances at both ends! Kalimuendo plays a wonderful ball into the box for Wood to sweep home but Trafford springs into action and makes a stunning save.

Leeds go up the other end, Okafor profiting from a diversionary run from centre-back Elvedi but cannot find the target and double Forest’s lead.

According to recent reports, end-to-end football! ⚡️First Wood, then Okafor - just 19 seconds between the two chances 😮#EFL | #CarabaoCup pic.twitter.com/TGQmtwLNwE.

Leeds are ahead and the inevitable chant from the away supporters is “can we play you every week?”.

This is of course their second meeting in four days and Leeds are on course to record the double.

Forest’s fans are starting to get a little twitchy.

Dan James puts Leeds United in front! ⚽️Tidy finish from the Welshman... #EFL | #CarabaoCup | @LUFC pic.twitter.com/GzWg6zLGLm.

Industry observers note that nottingham Forest 0 Leeds United 1 (James) We finally have a breakthrough. Kalimuendo gives the ball up cheaply in the middle of the park and Longstaff is there to pick up the pieces, darting infield before laying on a perfectly weighted for James to gallop on to, take a touch and sweep beyond Sels. The winger has been Leeds’ biggest threat and deserves that goal.

James finds space down the right - again - and his cross is closed down and deflected behind for a corner.

Longstaff’s floated delivery is tipped away by Sels, but it turns out that the ball went out before coming in so a Forest goal kick is awarded.

A lovely rendition of Mull of Kintyre precedes a short blast of the referee’s whistle and we’re back under way...

Schlager goes into the book instantly for grabbing a handful of Tanaka’s shirt as the Japan international attempted to escape his clutches.

This hasn’t been much of an improvement from Saturday.

Both teams are producing masterclasses in how to misplace passes. Oliver Glasner and Daniel Farke have spent much of the first half looking very frustrated.

James Trafford must be feeling very comfortable and confident of a second successive clean sheet after joining from Manchester City.

Let’s hope for an improvement in the second-half.

Recent findings suggest that should the scores remain level after 90 minutes, we will go straight to penalties. There’s still a half to play of course, but Forest’s League Cup shoot-out record should be a source of confidence having won seven from eight.

Leeds have only won four from 10.

Recent findings suggest that what a tackle from Joe Rodon! 💥#EFL | #CarabaoCup | @LUFC pic.twitter.com/p5GkzSFEoZ.

James wins the ball on the halfway line and feeds Okafor down the left. He attempts a deft through-ball into a thicket of bodies but it comes to nothing.

Leeds circulate the ball, working the ball from side to side but there is nowhere near enough movement in front of the ball-player for any meaningful forward passes to be played.

Industry observers note that and, quite aptly, the referee blows up at three seconds past 45 minutes. Certainly not a half for the books.

Another half-chance for Forest! Milenkovic lands on a second ball off a deep free-kick but he cannot keep his strike down. A classic centre-half’s effort if you will.

Ampadu comes over to the left to fire in a long throw-in. Sels comes steaming out of his goal and fumbles the ball but is awarded a free-kick after Muharemovic makes contact. Looked very minimal in all fairness.

Oof, a good chance for Aina! Williams’ cross from the left comes all the way through to his opposite wing-back, but Aina’s half-volley sails over. A cracking contact, though.

Industry observers note that elvedi and Muharemovic look to be astute buys from Leeds’ perspective. Both assured at the back and the latter especially is confident progressing the ball.

Just as I type that Forest threaten with a ball over the top, but Justin nips in to take the ball away from Wood.

It has been revealed that another decent opening for Leeds after a Forest turnover. Nmecha strides through the middle but Milenkovic is in position to ensure his run comes to nothing.

It has been revealed that what a tackle! Kalimuendo bursts through the middle after Leeds cede possession in a dangerous position. The winger plays in Wood who looks to be through on goal but Rodon comes out of nowhere to telescope a limb and stop the forward in his tracks. Fantastic defensive work from the Welshman.

Sources indicate that nmecha attempts to break beyond the halfway line but is stymied by a swarm of Forest players. He demands a foul from the referee who is not interested in the least.

It’s then Okafor’s turn to put in a dangerous cross from the left, but Nmecha cannot get to it.

Recent findings suggest that tanaka becomes the first man to go into the book. The ball gets away from him and Jesus puts body between man and ball smartly to win the foul.

Tanaka is now dropping into the back line to allow Leeds’ defenders the licence to get wider and higher. Forest will need to be wary of their opponents’ numerical advantage down the flanks.

It has been revealed that the game has reached something of a holding pattern as both sides resolve to slow things down, at least temporarily. Forest have settled into a slightly deeper block.

It has been revealed that sensing an opportunity, Ampadu spins in a glorious through-ball between centre-back and full-back for James to gallop on to. He hits the by-line and cuts back to Longstaff, but the midfielder can’t beat Sels. A good chance that probably should have been converted.

A good chance goes begging! 🫣Longstaff is free for Leeds but fires it straight at Sels...#EFL | #CarabaoCup pic.twitter.com/0UJdfSDQ6w.

Tanaka then turns provider, winning possession in Forest’s half before playing in Longstaff, whose cross-cum-shot does not threaten Sels’ goal.

Both sides have physical, quick out-balls, which has made for a frenetic encounter thus far. James rasps in another fierce cross from the right after another sweeping Leeds move, but Nmecha cannot get there and Tanaka fires well over on the follow-up.

Aina’s throw-in, this time from the left, is flicked on to Jesus at the back post and while the forward is able to direct the ball goalwards there is Justin on the line to clear the ball to safety.

Recent findings suggest that chance! Dominguez slides in Aina down the right channel and the full-back’s mishit cross has Trafford scrambling. He palms the ball behind for a corner, which is headed away for a Forest throw-in on the far side.

In a recent development, leeds are enjoying a spell of possession here, Tanaka and Longstaff peeling off into the wide areas to collect the ball and disrupt Forest’s mid-block out-of-possession structure. The hosts are more than happy for Leeds to circulate the ball in front of their first line of pressure as, for the second time tonight, Trafford boots it out into touch.

In a recent development, dominguez stands up a smart cross to the far post where Aina is waiting to head back across goal. Trafford backpedals into Kalimuendo and the referee awards Leeds a free-kick.

Wonderful touch there early in the game from none other than Oliver Glasner.

Forest’s head coach perfectly trapped a high ball as it landed towards him in the technical area.

James highlights off his speed for the first time tonight, accelerating down the right before fizzing a dangerous ball into the six-yard box but Forest clear their lines.

Sels goes long to Wood (feels like the right play given his attributes), James lands on the second ball but can only boot the ball into row Z to jeers from the home fans.

Aina introduces a long throw-in from the right and it’s headed behind for a corner. Trafford punches the inswinging delivery away and Williams’ effort from the edge of the box sails well over.

Industry observers note that forest are in their red home shirts, kicking from left to right. Leeds are in their yellow away number. Same set-up as the weekend.

Players and mascots walk on to the City Ground turf. A place in the League Cup third round on the line.

The first pre-match question put to Glasner by ITV was in relation to the reported £45m club-record deal for Chelsea forward Liam Delap. He responded: “I can tell everybody that he doesn’t play today. Everything else we shall see in the next days.”.

Oliver Glasner breaks his silence on Nottingham Forest's record signing, Liam Delap 🚨He speaks to @gabrielclarke05 ahead of Forest's Carabao Cup tie against Leeds 🗣️ pic.twitter.com/8DlWMIzVS9.

Reflecting on Saturday’s defeat by Leeds in his programme notes, Glasner wrote: “I saw plenty of encouraging signs from the team on Saturday and I felt we were a lot closer to scoring than we were conceding, especially in the second half. Unfortunately, the small margins were not on our side.

“I thought our defence looked comfortable, but there is still work to be done and the more the players get used to the system we’re operating, the more we’ll see that work come to fruition in competitive matches.

“We have recovered well and will be ready to give our all this evening.”.

It has been revealed that previewing tonight’s League Cup match, Leeds head coach Daniel Farke said: “Our league win is good for our mood and confidence, but this is a ‘do or die’ cup game. Both teams will be motivated to progress, so I expect a tight game. It will be difficult to win on the road again against a tough opponent.”.

Industry observers note that when asked what winning a first trophy of his managerial career would mean to him, Farke added: “Well, we weren’t too far away last season. Overall, I would say my form in cup competitions hasn’t been too bad during my career. I’m a substantial believer in these competitions, I like the ‘do or die’ mentality. I would never say no to another good cup run.”.

The hosts’ kits tonight will include Carabao Cup sleeve patches with the number four on them, in recognition of the club’s League Cup triumphs in 1978, 1979, 1989 and 1990.

Both managers have gone relatively strong for this tie, with only a sprinkling of debuts.

The major breaking news is that Forest are smashing their club record to sign Chelsea forward Liam Delap for £45m.

Delap will undergo a medical at Forest on Wednesday with the deal potentially rising to £50m after add-ons.

It eclipses the previous transfer record of £37.5m for winger Omari Hutchinson.

Oliver Glasner has prioritised the addition of a upcoming centre-forward this summer and Delap ticks pretty much every box for him.

Welcome to live coverage of the Carabao Cup second-round match between Nottingham Forest and Leeds United. This will be the sides’ second meeting at the City Ground in four days after Anton Stach’s late free-kick decided an attritional contest on the Premier League’s opening weekend. Forest’s upcoming head coach Oliver Glasner is something of a cup specialist, though, with FA Cup, Europa League and Conference League titles to his name and he will relish the opportunity to right the wrongs of Saturday in front of the Forest faithful.

According to recent reports, the Austrian is Forest’s fifth head coach in less than 12 months and he will look to arrest the churn by bringing to the City Ground the success he enjoyed with Crystal Palace. During pre-season, the Austrian moulded Forest into his preferred 3-4-3 shape, placing summer acquisition Ousmane Diomande alongside the existing central-defensive partnership of Murillo and Nikola Milenković. Here, Diomande gets his Forest debut and Glasner brings in talisman Chris Wood from the start.

Daniel Farke will have been delighted to see his Leeds side continue their excellent form in pre-season – which included victories over Liverpool, Red Bull Leipzig and Augsburg – into the season proper. Although Leeds arrive at the City Ground shorn of attacking options Wilfried Gnonto, Noah Okafor and Mateo Joseph through injury, Farke still shuffles the pack in the forward positions with this weekend’s visit of Brentford to Elland Road in mind.

In a recent development, jude Bellingham was a titan in England's midfield this evening. He literally is an action man, the way that he pops up all over the pitch.

Thomas Tuchel's gushing post-match comments about James Trafford certainly seem to be hinting at it.

Jordan Pickford has been a valiant servant for England. Across his 94 appearances, he's conceded 63 goals and managed 49 clean sheets. Add two World Cup semi-finals and two Euros finals to that list, and there's no denying that he's one of England's best of all time.

Yet Pickford is 32 now, and Trafford is 24. The changing of the guard is inevitable, and to have been dropped for such a big game against the world champions certainly feels like Tuchel is getting those wheels in motion.

Trafford repaid his faith tenfold. It is an exciting time for the Leeds goalkeeper, whose ceiling feels limitless. Pickford will be classy, as he always has been, amid this transition, but it won't be easy for the player who earned his first cap nine years ago under Gareth Southgate.

  • Il centrocampista parla del buon avvio di stagione e del clima nel gruppo.
  • Industry observers note that fisayo Dele-Bashiru è stato intervistato ai microfoni di Lazio Style Channel al rientro dagli impegni con la Nazionale, in vista della sfida di sabato tra Lazio e Lecce.
  • CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Il centrocampista parla del buon avvio di stagione e del clima nel gruppo.

Industry observers note that fisayo Dele-Bashiru è stato intervistato ai microfoni di Lazio Style Channel al rientro dagli impegni con la Nazionale, in vista della sfida di sabato tra Lazio e Lecce. Nel confronto racconta l'energia portata da Gattuso, la concorrenza interna e la voglia di dare il massimo per la squadra.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sto bene. Sono felice di essere tornato a Roma. Naturalmente, essere convocato in Nazionale è sempre un momento speciale, soprattutto in occasione delle qualificazioni alla Coppa d'Africa. Le partite sono andate abbastanza bene. La prima è stata positiva, la seconda poteva andare meglio, ma sono felice di essere tornato a Roma. Nel fine settimana ci aspetta una partita importante e non vediamo l'ora di giocarla.

Penso che quest'anno abbiamo iniziato molto bene con Gattuso. Ha portato nuova energia nello spogliatoio e credo che questo si veda nei rapporti tra i compagni, nel nostro rapporto con l'allenatore e anche in quello con i tifosi. Se riusciremo a continuare su questa strada, sarà perfetto.

Tanto, in questo momento c'è molta concorrenza. Quando ho l'opportunità di entrare in campo per aiutare la squadra, cerco sempre di dare il massimo. Se dovessi giocare nel fine settimana, darò come sempre tutto me stesso. Credo che questo sia importante perché, per arrivare lontano in campionato, non bisogna poter contare soltanto sugli undici titolari: anche i giocatori in panchina devono dare il proprio contributo. È fondamentale.

Recent findings suggest that credo che la concorrenza sia sicuramente positiva e faccia bene. Tutte le migliori squadre del mondo hanno molta competizione interna e penso che questo permetta alla squadra di esprimere al meglio. In questo momento l'atmosfera è molto buona. Credo che nello spogliatoio ci siano molte più battute e momenti di leggerezza rispetto alla scorsa stagione, quando la situazione era differente. Quest'anno siamo molto più uniti e questo contribuisce sicuramente a creare un bel clima all'interno del gruppo.

Da quando sono alla Lazio ho avuto diversi allenatori. Credo che quest'anno un aspetto importante sia il grande coinvolgimento di Gattuso nel lavoro con il gruppo e con ogni singolo giocatore. Ha un ottimo rapporto con tutti i componenti della squadra e penso che questo sia fondamentale. Inoltre, sa perfettamente cosa significhi essere in campo ai massimi livelli, avendo avuto una grande carriera da calciatore. È un allenatore di altissimo livello, tutti i ragazzi gli vogliono bene e dobbiamo continuare a ottenere risultati per lui.

Sources indicate that A livello personale sono una persona piuttosto tranquilla. Non lascio che quello che succede all'esterno influenzi troppo il mio modo di essere. Penso di comportarmi in campo proprio come nella vita di tutti i giorni: sono abbastanza rilassato e calmo, anche se so essere aggressivo quando serve. Direi che queste sono le caratteristiche che mi descrivono meglio.

Recent findings suggest that A livello personale, il mio obiettivo è giocare il maggior numero possibile di partite e aiutare la squadra il più possibile, magari con gol e assist. Se riuscirò a fare tutto questo, penso che sarà una stagione davvero molto positiva, non soltanto per me, ma anche per tutti i ragazzi. Adesso dobbiamo semplicemente continuare a lavorare partita dopo partita. Speriamo di riuscire a proseguire su questa buona strada.

L'anticipo di Galli - “I love Cisse”, disse Amorim. E aveva ragione

💡 Key Takeaways

  • Qualche parola in più, tuttavia, voglio spenderla su Alphadjo Cisse che, a vent’anni appena compiuti, dopo 14 presenze nell’U21, ha fatto il suo esordio con la Nazionale italiana nella partita contro il Belgio.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, la sosta di Campionato ha visto diversi rossoneri impegnati con le loro Nazionali. Le prestazioni sono state nel complesso positive: Rabiot e Maignan, pur senza brillare, si sono qualificati con la loro Francia per i quarti di finale di Nations League; qualche preoccupazione per il nostro portierone che ha riportato un infortunio all’anca, che tuttavia non dovrebbe impedirgli di giocare contro il Frosinone. Molto bene Diego Moreira, tra i protagonisti, segnando anche un goal nella lezione impartita dal Belgio agli azzurri. Qualche ombra arriva invece da Gonçalo Ramos, rimasto a digiuno con il Portogallo, già qualificato ai quarti, sia nella partita casalinga con la Danimarca (i danesi hanno vinto 4-1 e Gonçalo non ha toccato un pallone nel cuore della difesa avversaria), sia nella trasferta in Galles (vittoria 3-2 per gli uomini di Jorge Jesus). Il suo collega di reparto, Francesco Camarda è invece andato in goal con l’Under 21 nell’amichevole con i pari età francesi, un’iniezione di fiducia per il prodotto del nostro vivaio in attesa di sapere quale sarà il suo destino nel mercato invernale. Anche Christian Pulisic torna ulteriormente rinfrancato dopo il doppio confronto tra USA e Haiti (certo non così probante), grazie ai due goal segnati nella prima gara, cui ha fatto seguito il bellissimo goal in rovesciata nella seconda.

Qualche parola in più, tuttavia, voglio spenderla su Alphadjo Cisse che, a vent’anni appena compiuti, dopo 14 presenze nell’U21, ha fatto il suo esordio con la Nazionale italiana nella partita contro il Belgio. Un’esperienza che non ho mai avuto la gioia di vivere ma che immagino come qualcosa di indimenticabile o, se preferite, unforgettable (J). Una carica di energia e consapevolezza che - ne sono certo - il ragazzo saprà utilizzare a favore della squadra, dove peraltro ha già segnato a ripetizione fra campionato e Coppa.

Nel suo debutto azzurro, Alphadjo è subentrato a Scalvini al 17’ della ripresa con la squadra sotto per 3-1, non certo il migliore dei contesti. Il suo approccio è stato perfetto: ha mostrato la solita naturalezza e ha provato a rendersi subito protagonista con il gesto tecnico che, per quanto prevedibile, è difficile da neutralizzare: il destro a giro sul palo lontano della porta avversaria scoccato in prossimità del vertice sinistro dell’area, un’esecuzione che ha procurato il rigore poi fallito da Pio Esposito.

Ma chi è Alphadjo, calcisticamente? Come si sa, gli osservatori del Milan lo seguivano da tempo e lo hanno intercettato ufficialmente a metà dello scorso campionato, quando, in prestito dal Verona, stava giocando in serie B al Catanzaro, sotto la guida di Alberto Aquilani. Quando ormai la sua partenza in direzione PSV Eindhoven sembrava decisa, la società rossonera si è inserita e se lo è assicurato per una cifra attorno ai 10 milioni, lasciandolo a Catanzaro fino a fine stagione. Un grave infortunio nel febbraio di quest’anno lo ha tenuto lontano dalle competizioni fino alla scorsa estate gettando enormi dubbi sul suo completo recupero. Invece il ragazzo nato in provincia di Treviso è tornato in campo ancora più determinato, a dimostrazione di come il talento abbia bisogno di motivazione e resilienza per emergere. Si pensava che potesse passare dal Milan Futuro, e invece Amorim se ne è innamorato (indimenticabile quel “I love Cisse”, subito dopo aver dichiarato di non voler parlare di singoli giocatori): e il suo pupillo lo ha ricambiato andando subito in gol (destro a girare partendo da sinistra, of course) nell’esordio contro il Torino.

In a recent development, il nostro numero 70, alto 1,78 per una settantina di chili, dotato di gambe molto forti che gli permettono di dribblare, di difendere la palla e di vincere contrasti, può giocare in diversi ruoli o, meglio, svolgere diverse funzioni: seconda punta, mezzala, trequartista ed esterno. Credo che da esterno, sul lato sinistro del campo, possa esprimersi al meglio perché può rientrare dentro al campo e tentare la “sua” giocata, di cui abbiamo già parlato. Cisse ha comunque un’abilità nella lettura degli spazi in cui può ricevere palla che gli permette di seguire lo sviluppo del gioco e di essere efficace in ogni situazione: intelligente, ad esempio, il suo movimento a occupare lo spazio lasciato libero da Gonçalo Ramos, che a sua volta determina quello dei difendenti rossoblù, per trovare l’impatto con la palla, servitagli da Pulisic, per il goal del vantaggio rossonero a Marassi, nell’ultima gara prima della sosta. Abbastanza impressionante anche la tripletta in Europa League contro il Salisburgo, con gol di testa, di destro e di sinistro, tutti segnati nell’area piccola dimostrando anche un grande opportunismo da prima punta. Qualcosa in più forse dovrà dare in fase difensiva dal punto di vista attentivo, ma la cosiddetta “self regulation”, cioè l’attitudine a volersi migliorare in allenamento e in partita, col tempo lo aiuterà a crescere anche nei compiti senza palla.

Non dimentichiamoci che il ragazzo è il nostro capocannonierecon 8 goal, di cui 5 in campionato in 9 presenze, per un totale di 407 minuti (5 da titolare e 4 da subentrato). Non male per un ventenne. Da domenica ci attende un tour de force di 7 partite in 28 giorni, ci sarà bisogno di tutti e avremo bisogno che Alpha, così lo chiamano compagni ed amici, continui a stupire!

L’appuntamento sarebbe stato fissato mercoledì 18 novembre alle ore 12 nello studio notarile a Chiaia in via dei Mille di Francesco Coppa. Si tratta di un acquisto preliminare, che riguarderebbe suoli per 13 ettari, anche se in futuro nell’affare potrebbero rientrare almeno altri cinque ettari di terreni. Con le firme sui contratti, il presidente e la societ diventeranno ufficialmente proprietari di quasi 13 ettari in località Pozzo Nuovo a Qualiano. Perché ora il Napoli ha fretta di spostarsi nella sua nuova casa: e quindi, verrà data la priorità alla realizzazione di (almeno) tre campi di calcio necessari per gli allenamenti della prima squadra, gli spogliatoi, le palestre, le piscine, le aree dei massaggi e quelle per gli uffici. E di una palazzina per il ristoro. Poi, solo in un secondo momento, si aprirà il cantiere per la foresteria e per la realizzazione di un convitto per i giovani. Lo scrive Il Corriere del Mezzogiorno.

Il centrocampista classe 2011 è stato impiegato da Rughetti in tutte le partite della stagione.

Andrea Morresi è il regista del centrocampo della Lazio di Rughetti. Secondo quanto riportato da Gazzetta Regionale, Il classe 2011, arrivato dal Perugia nell’estate del 2025, gioca davanti alla difesa ed è stato impiegato dal tecnico in tutte le partite di questa stagione. Nel derby con la Roma, un suo filtrante ha messo Coppola nelle condizioni di segnare il gol del momentaneo 2-1.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Morresi era approdato nella capitale nella passata stagione, entrando nell’Under 15. Si è preso presto le chiavi della mediana biancoceleste, interpretando il ruolo di playmaker anche nel campionato attuale. La sua presenza è un punto fermo nelle scelte di Rughetti.

Sources indicate that prima del passaggio al Perugia, Morresi è cresciuto nel settore giovanile della Treiese, dai Piccoli Amici ai Pulcini. L’arrivo alla Lazio nell’estate del 2025 ha aperto una nuova tappa del suo percorso: con la maglia biancoceleste ha trovato spazio stabilmente davanti alla difesa.

Sources indicate that in quella posizione gestisce il pallone, distribuisce il gioco e cerca gli spazi per i compagni. Alla visione di gioco unisce tecnica e corsa nelle due fasi. Il suo destro si è già fatto notare anche sui calci di punizione, una soluzione con cui può rendersi decisivo.

It has been revealed that il suo contributo non si esaurisce però nella regia arretrata. Quando si apre la possibilità, Morresi avanza verso la trequarti avversaria. È dunque coinvolto sia nella costruzione delle azioni sia nel lavoro che precede le iniziative offensive della squadra.

According to recent reports, fino alla domenica del derby, la Lazio condivideva con la Roma l’imbattibilità in campionato. I biancocelesti si presentavano alla sfida con una struttura difensiva che li rendeva la seconda miglior difesa del raggruppamento. Anche il lavoro di Morresi davanti alla retroguardia contribuisce all’equilibrio della squadra.

Recent findings suggest that contro i giallorossi, il numero 4 ha giocato in una zona di campo particolarmente affollata. Dall’altra parte c’era il miglior attacco del girone, capace di mettere alla prova la mediana biancoceleste. La Roma ha prevalso per 3-1 dopo aver dominato gran parte degli 80 minuti, ma nella ripresa la Lazio ha trovato la forza di reagire.

It has been revealed that L’episodio che ha riaperto momentaneamente la partita è nato dai piedi di Morresi. Un suo passaggio filtrante ha raggiunto Coppola in posizione favorevole; il compagno ha poi mandato il pallone in rete per il 2-1. La speranza biancoceleste si è spenta con il terzo gol romanista, firmato da Abate.

Il mercato di gennaio resta incerto: Lotito cerca il via libera e Fabiani valuta anche il centrocampista apprezzato da Gattuso.

Marco Brescianini e Denis Man sono due profili sondati da Fabiani per la Lazio, mentre resta da chiarire se il club potrà operare nel mercato di gennaio. Secondo quanto riportato da Lottomatica, Lotito sta lavorando a un piano economico-finanziario che permetta al direttore sportivo di cercare rinforzi per Gattuso, secondo quanto riferisce Lottomatica.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Sources indicate that fino a qualche settimana fa, il blocco del mercato sembrava quasi certo. Lotito punta però a ottenere il via libera della Commissione indipendente, che ha preso il posto della Covisoc.

Tra le operazioni su cui lavora ci sono l’anticipo dei crediti futuri legati alle sponsorizzazioni e una proroga per dilazionare il pagamento delle vecchie imposte relative agli anni del Covid. Dall’esito di questo lavoro dipende la possibilità per Fabiani di intervenire a gennaio.

According to recent reports, nel frattempo, Fabiani sta valutando diversi calciatori. Uno dei nomi indicati è Marco Brescianini, che la fonte presenta come giocatore di proprietà della Fiorentina. Gattuso lo apprezza soprattutto per la capacità di inserirsi in area di rigore.

L’operazione non viene considerata semplice. La Lazio può comunque contare su un elemento nei rapporti per un’eventuale trattativa: Brescianini ha lo stesso agente di Pinamonti.

Savio scores on debut as Spurs cruise past Charlton in Carabao Cup

💡 Key Takeaways
  • It looked like this was going to be a night for “one of their own”, but Tottenham Hotspur’s latest substantial-money arrival, Sávio, stole the headlines to crank up the excitement at his latest club.
  • Mikey Moore had set Spurs on their way to what proved a comfortable Carabao Cup success over Championship club Charlton Athletic and heard his name sung by the home fans.
  • But Sávio stepped off the substitutes’ bench to take the limelight with a late goal just a few days after completing his expensive switch from Manchester City, and head coach Roberto De Zerbi is demanding many more to come.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

It looked like this was going to be a night for “one of their own”, but Tottenham Hotspur’s latest substantial-money arrival, Sávio, stole the headlines to crank up the excitement at his latest club.

Mikey Moore had set Spurs on their way to what proved a comfortable Carabao Cup success over Championship club Charlton Athletic and heard his name sung by the home fans.

But Sávio stepped off the substitutes’ bench to take the limelight with a late goal just a few days after completing his expensive switch from Manchester City, and head coach Roberto De Zerbi is demanding many more to come.

“A perfect day for him,” noted De Zerbi. “His biggest improvement is to increase the number of goals. He is one of the best wingers, but the best wingers score many goals and I spoke with him two days ago, and we put the goal at 10-12 goals.

Sources indicate that “We need 10-12 goals from the wingers. Last season, we suffered too much because the number of goals were not enough.”.

"What an introduction!"Sávio scores a brilliant goal on his Spurs debut! 👏 pic.twitter.com/WgmcfgeNpX.

Having watched some of Tottenham’s signings fall to a 3-0 Premier League defeat by Brentford a few days earlier, Sávio’s late impact was the perfect lift for the Spurs supporters.

The club have committed to spending almost £400m this summer, leading to debate by outsiders over whether it will prove to be money well spent and huge waves of excitement within the fanbase.

A deal that could be worth as much as £85m, if add-ons are achieved, for Sávio certainly raised some eyebrows, but the Brazilian provided the perfect response by scoring just 11 minutes into his debut as a late substitute.

In a recent development, in the 82nd minute, Sávio cut in from the flank and scored with a shot past Charlton goalkeeper Tiernan Brooks. He and the Spurs crowd thought he had a second a few minutes later, but his shot hit Ben Davies on its way into the net and the defender was credited with the goal.

Having sung for Moore earlier in the game, the Spurs fans wasted no time in trying out their new song for Sávio, inspired by the Spandau Ballet hit Gold.

Moore has been expected to move to Cologne on loan, but provided a reminder of his talent by opening the scoring in the first half with only his second goal for the club.

What a hit from Mikey Moore! ⚪ pic.twitter.com/OgSM4qhiqs.

“We have to understand the best solution,” De Zerbi said. “I would like to keep him. He’s young but a good player, but we can’t make the wrong decision. He needs to play, he needs to get games inside him.”.

Industry observers note that cutting in from the right, where Sávio is primed to play, Moore surged past his marker and shot from just inside the box. Brooks should have stopped it, but the ball flew past him and into the net.

Three minutes after Moore’s opener, Dominic Solanke scored his first goal since March to offer a reminder of what he can still give De Zerbi, who is poised to welcome Omar Marmoush to Tottenham.

According to recent reports, buoyed by his first-half goal, Moore skipped his way around a couple of tackles at the start of the second period but his low cross was cut out. The Spurs fans responded by singing “he’s one of our own.”.

Substitute Kevin Danso netted with his first touch from a header, before Sávio was introduced to steal the show, despite a late consolation goal from Charlton’s Lloyd Jones.

In a recent development, kevin Danso scores with his first touch since coming on! ⚪ pic.twitter.com/oqUU7wjoJW.

The victory set up a tough third-round trip to Anfield to face Liverpool for Tottenham, but De Zerbi stated: “It’s a great game. If we want to win the competition we have to win the games.

“Sometimes in this competition, it can happen that you play against significant teams. It’s a great challenge for the players, for me, for our clubs. We have to arrive ready to play in our style, with personality, ready to play a game following the work we are doing on the training ground.”.

In a recent development, “He did great when he came on. He is going to be a joy for all of us to watch. I am sure he will be a fan favourite. He showed what a player he is tonight. To get one goal and an assist on his debut is great.”.

Premier League: Brighton, Arsenal, Brentford, Everton, Hull, Ipswich, Manchester City, Liverpool, Newcastle, Bournemouth, Sunderland, Crystal Palace, Manchester United, Coventry, Tottenham, Aston Villa.

Championship: Millwall, Wolves, Middlesbrough, Sheffield United, West Ham, Lincoln, Norwich.

The teams in the hat for the League Cup third round will found out who they will face very shortly and we will let you know all the ties for the third round.

It is all over in north London and Tottenham have booked their place in the third round of the League Cup with a comfortable 5-1 win over Charlton.

Three added minutes in north London.

Newcastle have just about got past West Brom, winning 3-2 in the end, and they book their place in the third round.

At least the travelling Charlton fans have something to cheer about even if their side are being dumped out of the League Cup. A corner from the left comes to the back post, where Jones rises highest to head it between Kinsky’s legs and into the Tottenham net.

Savio thinks he has his second in quick succession but it will go down as Davies’ goal. Savio’s shot was on target but it deflects off Davies and goes in for Tottenham’s fifth on the night.

According to recent reports, the Brazilian signed just yesterday but he now has a first Tottenham goal to his name. He cuts inside from the right and drives across the face of the penalty area before firing at the near post, beating Brooks. Tottenham are cruising into the third round and their newest signing scores on his debut.

"What an introduction!"Sávio scores a brilliant goal on his Spurs debut! 👏 pic.twitter.com/WgmcfgeNpX.

Tottenham are cruising into the third round and so are Everton, who lead Preston by the same scoreline. Newcastle lead West Brom 3-2 whilst it is still 0-0 between Bradford and Burnley.

Change for Tottenham as Williams-Barnett replaces Tel.

Tel crosses from the left side of the box and picks out Savio, who attempts an audacious flick that does not come off.

West Brom were not back on level terms for long as Barnes has his second of the game and Newcastle lead 3-2 with under 10 minutes remaining.

Charlton have barely threatened the Tottenham goal tonight but that is a decent opportunity for Leaburn, who is played in down the right and forces Kinsky into a decent save.

Savio is straight into the action with good work down the right and squares it for Tel, whose shot is straight at Brooks.

In a recent development, savio is on for his Tottenham debut and replaces Solanke. Savio only joined Tottenham yesterday but makes his first appearance for the club tonight.

Sources indicate that newcastle had fought from 1-0 down against West Brom to lead 2-1 but Hall has just given away a penalty for the second time in a matter of days having also conceded one in the dying moments of their 2-2 draw against Liverpool on Sunday. Price has stepped up to score his second of the game to bring West Brom level at 2-2 with just over 10 minutes to go.

Recent findings suggest that the Austrian defender has just come on and, with his first touch, puts Tottenham 3-0 up. Fernandes’ free-kick from just outside the box on the right is met by Danso, who attacks it and his header finds the bottom corner. You have to say that goal was coming. Danso has hurt himself as there was a clash of heads as he met the delivery and receives treatment to his head.

Sources indicate that kevin Danso scores with his first touch since coming on! ⚪ pic.twitter.com/oqUU7wjoJW.

Roberto De Zerbi is turning to his bench and making a triple change as Van de Ven, Danso and Porro come on.

Charlton are also making a triple change of their own.

Gray is found on the left side of the Charlton penalty area and he drives his shot towards goal, forcing Brooks into a decent save. Tottenham are pushing for that third goal.

A cross is sent in from the right and it comes to Tel, who volleys first time but it is a fairly routine save for Brooks in the Charlton goal.

Sources indicate that tottenham are starting to ramp up the pressure as they go in search of a third goal. As it stands, the only side that looks like scoring is Tottenham.

According to recent reports, plenty of cheers from the home fans as Savio is out to warm up. Will Roberto De Zerbi turn to the Brazilian and give him his debut tonight?

One of the new laws brought in this season is to speed up throw-ins and Gray falls foul of taking too long, with Charlton then being given the throw-in.

Tel decides to shoot from range after Charlton clear a corner but the Frenchman’s effort is straight at Brooks.

Play has resumed in north London, with Tottenham 2-0 up over Charlton.

According to recent reports, they are back under way at St James’ Park and there has been a goal within a few minutes of the second half starting. Newcastle were 1-0 down against West Brom but they now lead 2-1 thanks to Barnes’ goal.

Possession: Tottenham 76%-24% CharltonShots: 9-2Shots on target: 4-1Corners: 7-2Touches in opposition box: 25-2.

The first half in north London is brought to an end and Tottenham take a 2-0 lead into the break thanks to goals from Moore and Solanke. Tottenham looked rather lethargic for a lot of that first half but two goals in quick succession has Roberto De Zerbi’s side in control. As the players head off, the DJ pays homage to the late Dolly Parton by blasting out Nine to Five.

Whilst they are still in added time in north London, it is half-time at St James’ Park and Newcastle are level 1-1 with West Brom.

Apter is booked for cynically tripping up Udogie.

Due to a few Charlton injuries, there will be six added minutes.

Like London buses, two goals come in quick succession and Tottenham have their second just before the break. Charlton fail to clear their lines inside their own box before Solanke volleys in on the swivel from the penalty spot. Charlton will feel that was definitely an avoidable goal.

Tottenham had looked rather lethargic but they take the lead in emphatic style. The 19-year-old cuts inside from the right and comes across the face of the Charlton penalty area. Moore then strikes it powerfully with his left foot and the ball flies into the roof of the net. Could Brooks have done better in the Charlton goal? Moore will not care.

It has been revealed that what a hit from Mikey Moore! ⚪ pic.twitter.com/OgSM4qhiqs.

Tottenham are currently too slow in possession and are not moving the ball promptly enough, meaning it is easier for Charlton to defend.

West Brom had taken the lead at St James’ Park but Newcastle are back on level terms through summer signing Toure.

A corner from the right ends up coming out to the edge of the box, where Tel takes it first time but his volley goes a long way wide. That moment sums up Tottenham’s evening thus far.

Solanke has a shot from the edge of the box blocked before Gray’s effort with the outside of his right foot is saved well by Brooks down to his left. That looked like it was creeping in so Brooks had to get a hand to that.

In a recent development, charlton play the corner short and eventually the ball comes in. Asiimwe meets it and has a good chance from eight yards out but his header goes just wide. That was a decent chance for Charlton.

In a recent development, the first booking of the night goes the way of the hosts as Bergvall cynically takes down Apter as the Charlton man drove towards the Tottenham penalty area. You feel like Charlton need to take advantage of opportunities like this if they want to win this tie. The ball is clipped in and it comes off Van Hecke’s head for a corner. Tottenham clear their lines initially but Charlton keep it alive. Docherty strikes it first time from the edge of the Tottenham box and forces Kinsky into a good save diving to his left.

According to recent reports, that probably sums up Tottenham’s night thus far. Davies pings a lovely diagonal ball out to Moore in space down Tottenham’s right. Moore waits for the overlapping run of Gray before playing the pass but Gray’s attempted cross from the right side of the box is terrible and goes behind for a goal kick. Roberto De Zerbi is quickly out of his seat!

Roberto De Zerbi was keen to see his side show a reaction to their defeat at Brentford on Saturday. Unsurprisingly, they are dominating possession but have not posed much of a threat going forward.

Sources indicate that there has been a goal at St James’ Park and it is the visitors West Brom who have taken the lead over Newcastle. Price has scored directly from a free-kick and the Championship side lead.

A sensational free-kick from Isaac Price to give West Brom the lead at St. James' Park! 🤯Watch the Carabao Cup here! - https://t.co/4BMyhp9stB pic.twitter.com/Pnt78LWFN6.

Things have just gone from bad to worse for Charlton. Whilst one of their centre-backs is being stretchered off in Sichenje, their other centre-half Koumetio, who used to be on the books at Liverpool, is also down. Koumetio, like Sichenje, is going to come off. McNamara and Jones, who like Koumetio used to be at Liverpool, are coming on. Charlton have had to change both centre-backs inside the opening quarter of an hour.

In a recent development, sichenje did try to continue but he has gone back down again and his night appears to be over. The question will be has he done more damage to his knee trying to play on? The stretcher is being brought on and it will be a sorry end to his night.

It has been revealed that moore wins Tottenham a corner out on the right, which summer signing Fernandes will take. His delivery is headed away and the danger is gone.

Sichenje has now got back to his feet so he may have avoided a serious injury but we will see if he can continue. It looks like he will try to continue at least.

Recent findings suggest that play is halted as Charlton defender Sichenje looks to be in a lot of pain as he bangs the ground in frustration. It appears to be his left knee and the visitors may be forced into an early change.

Inside the opening minute, Solanke thinks he will have a chance on goal as the ball is played in behind but there is too much on it and the ball goes through to Brooks in the Charlton goal.

We are under way in north London.

Sources indicate that both sides emerge from the tunnel at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium and we are just moments away from kick-off north London. Here is a reminder of how the two sides line up this evening:.

It has been revealed that A place in the League Cup third round is at stake as Tottenham host Charlton in a London derby at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. The last competitive meeting between these sides came in the FA Cup back in January 2011, with Tottenham winning that game 3-0 at White Hart Lane. A then 19-year-old Andros Townsend made his debut that day and scored, with Jermain Defoe scoring a brace.

Tottenham’s Premier League campaign got off to the worst possible start as they lost 3-0 at Brentford last weekend. Tottenham have been very busy during this summer transfer window and that has continued this week. Savio (formerly Savinho) has arrived from Manchester City in a deal that could be worth £85m and the Brazilian could make his Tottenham debut tonight, having been registered in time.

Industry observers note that “I think in attacking positions we need players capable one-on one, to create something, to create a chance to score,” Roberto De Zerbi remarked. “In terms of one-on-one, he [Savio] is one of the best players, especially since 2024. He can play on the right side, on the left side. I have known him from a long time, I spoke with him when he went to Manchester City. He is a substantial player for us.

“I do not know if I am the right man [to get the most out of Savio], but for sure he has to achieve. I think a player who is so good in one-on-one, so good at creating chances to score, to be complete, he has to score. If you analyse the other best wingers in the world, many of them, they score 10 to 15 goals per season. He has the qualities. Maybe his habits, he has to change habits, because he has to be focused on the assists, the one-on-one dribbling and also to score.”.

Sources indicate that omar Marmoush is closing in on an initial loan deal from Manchester City but that move is not complete and thus he is not available for Tottenham tonight. Micky van der Ven and Pedro Porro are both available having missed Tottenham’s loss at Brentford but the hosts are still without Xavi Simons, Pape Sarr, Dejan Kulusevski and Wilson Odobert.

Charlton have made the perfect start to their Championship campaign; a 2-1 home win over Derby was followed up by a 2-1 victory at recently-relegated West Ham. Nathan Jones’ side earned their place in the League Cup second round with a 3-1 win at Cheltenham in the first round.

It has been revealed that “We have to be very organised and very professional, they [Tottenham] are a top team,” Jones remarked. “They have a great manager and a brilliant group of players. They already had a Premier League squad and they have spent, what is reaching about, I do not know, £300 million or something like that. It is a wonderful test, we have to be right near our best and do both sides of the game very well. Of course, you want to test yourself against the best managers and you want to test yourself against the best teams. For us, this is not our priority, the Championship is our priority, but this is the next game and therefore it is the most crucial.”.

Published: 18:10 EST, 15 November 2026 | Updated: 19:58 EST, 15 November 2026.

Thomas Tuchel hailed the 'best performance of my time as manager' after England beat world champions Spain in a crazy, brilliant see-sawing drama of a Nations League tie.

England played the best football of Tuchel's two-year reign as coach to end Spain's world record 43-match unbeaten run.

England raced into a 3-0 lead with a penalty from Harry Kane, and further goals from Ezri Konsa and Ben White.

But they played the last half an hour of the game with ten men after Elliot Anderson was sent off for pulling back Lamine Yamal.

Spain got two goals back to set up a nerve-wracking finish but goalkeeper James Trafford, in the team ahead of Jordan Pickford, pulled off a miracle double save in the dying minutes to seal the win.

It has been revealed that 'What a performance we put out there for 60 minutes to be deservedly 3-0 up,' Tuchel said after the game. 'Thirty minutes against Spain with ten men feels like three hours.

Thomas Tuchel mentioned England's display in the win over Spain was the best in his time as boss.

It has been revealed that 'It was a statement victory. It was on the highest level football-wise. It is a wonderful feeling for us in the dressing room.

According to recent reports, 'It is the best performance of my time and they are unbeaten for 43 matches and that was a complete performance in that environment. To impose our identity on them was a real achievement.

It has been revealed that 'Declan Rice stated he knew we were going to win and I could feel the true belief. This was the moment we wanted to prove ourselves. You need to rely on your teammates. That is why I am very proud of the win.'.

Tuchel also questioned the decision to give Anderson a straight red, made by a referee he once labelled a 'one out of 10'.

The Man City midfielder was sent off because Clement Turpin adjudged him not to have been making an attempt to play the ball when he fouled Yamal.

'The red card and the penalty is always a major decision and I needed to understand why it was a double punishment but... OK,' Tuchel told ITV Sport.

'From then it was a long 30 minutes but I don't want to focus on that because there were so, so many positives.'.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Lotito e Fabiani conoscono dal 15 novembre la cifra da coprire; resta il nodo della liquidità per gli acquisti.

La Lazio può ancora evitare il blocco totale del mercato invernale. Secondo quanto riportato da Il Messaggero, Lotito e Fabiani conoscono dal 15 novembre la cifra da coprire, ma non hanno ancora consegnato i documenti alla Commissione di controllo. Il termine è il 30 novembre; l’organismo li esaminerà a dicembre. Anche un eventuale via libera, però, non garantirebbe alla società la liquidità necessaria per acquistare senza vendere giocatori importanti.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Gli acquisti estivi e l’aumento degli ingaggi hanno peggiorato l’indice del Costo del lavoro allargato, portandolo oltre il limite previsto per operare a saldo zero. Lotito lavora da mesi per rientrare attraverso crediti futuri e altri asset. Potrebbe inoltre intervenire successivamente con un’immissione di denaro, così da scongiurare il blocco e mantenere la libertà di operare sul mercato.

Il passaggio immediato resta la presentazione della documentazione entro il 30 novembre. fino a questo momento non è stata consegnata alla Commissione, chiamata a valutarla nel mese di dicembre.

Superare il limite consentirebbe alla Lazio di entrare nel mercato, ma la possibilità di operare non coinciderebbe necessariamente con quella di comprare. Anche ottenendo il via libera, il club potrebbe non disporre della liquidità per effettuare acquisti senza cedere pezzi da novanta.

In a recent development, su questo punto si concentrerà il prossimo vertice con Gattuso. Sarà l’allenatore a indicare la strada, tenendo conto sia dei margini di mercato sia della possibilità di conservare la rosa attuale.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Arsenal will host old nemesis José Mourinho’s Real Madrid in the league phase of the Champions League.

Mourinho, the former Chelsea, Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur manager, will return to London to resume hostilities against last season’s beaten finalists.

Other reunions from Thursday’s draw include Manchester City travelling to Barcelona, to whom they last week sold Rodri, and Liverpool visiting Inter Milan, who have signed Curtis Jones.

Industry observers note that arsenal will also travel to Harry Kane’s Bayern Munich, while United will host the Germans as well on their Champions League return in a repeat of the legendary 1999 final. Michael Carrick’s side will also visit Cesc Fàbregas’s Como.

Mourinho last managed at the Emirates Stadium in March 2021, barely a month before his sacking by Spurs.

During his two spells as Chelsea manager, Mourinho famously had run-ins with Arsenal’s Arsène Wenger.

Mourinho called Wenger a “specialist in failure” after the Frenchman failed to add to his three Premier League titles following his Portuguese counterpart’s arrival in London in 2004.

Last season, Mikel Arteta finally ended Arsenal’s long wait to be crowned champions of England but agonisingly missed out on European glory.

Verdict Premier League champions should not be daunted by any game, but Real Madrid – with Mourinho in control – has the feel of a defining match of the group stage. Facing Kane in Munich does not seem any easier. Some tough assignments here including a trip to Napoli but the pot-four teams seem straightforward for Mikel Arteta.

Industry observers note that verdict Playing against the European champions and travelling to Barcelona will be a true test of how much progress Enzo Maresca has made in the short time he has been at the Etihad Stadium. City’s other games do not look easy either but they should be defeating teams such as Sporting Lisbon and Porto – at least they would be expected to under Pep Guardiola.

In a recent development, verdict The San Siro was where Arne Slot began to turn results around last season and Iraola getting a win there would be a big statement. Atlético staged a comeback at Anfield in 2020 and the repeat fixture will be tight. But there are enough winnable games there for Liverpool to reach the next round.

Verdict They will face a wall of noise in Istanbul when they play Galatasaray, but Villa will look to get points from the game. There are some tasty destinations for travelling fans and getting results there will ease the pressure on the match against PSG, who have been rattled by Villa before but remain a difficult opponent. The Nou Camp is a place where momentum can change in a season – for good or bad.

Verdict The repeat of the 1999 final is the standout fixture, but Michael Carrick should be looking beyond that match for the points needed to progress. He has been given a tough set of away games to navigate. They are winnable but difficult. So those games at Old Trafford will be very important.

That brings our coverage of the Champions League draw to an end, as the 36 teams found which eight teams they will be facing in the league phase of this season’s tournament. Thanks for joining us!

The league phase will kick off on 8 September and will be wrapped up after all teams play at the same time on 27 January.

The top eight teams of the league phase progress to the last 16 automatically, while teams that finish between ninth and 24th will be forced to navigate a play-off tie to reach the knockout stages.

So we have 144 fixtures decided but there are certainly a few heavyweight contests which stand out:.

It has been revealed that that brings the draw to an end! Just a reminder that the order of the fixtures is based on the pots and the respective home and away fixtures within the pots, rather than chronology.

In a recent development, that is pots two and three done. Just the pot four teams to sort out now, finding out which other pot four teams they will face.

Some crackers in there. Up next we will be finding out all the opponents for the pot two teams.

In a recent development, there is a fairly extensive video explanation of the format at the moment taking place. We should you be bringing you some fixtures very shortly...

It has been revealed that the draw is now getting underway. Uefa deputy general secretary Giorgio Marchetti comes on stage to oversee proceedings. A reminder of the format:.

The 36 teams will be split into four pots of nine, based on “club coefficient rankings”, with defending champions Paris St-Germain automatically named as the top seed.

CONFIRMED: #UCLdraw pots for the league phase 👀 pic.twitter.com/LpMjiap6RF.

It has been revealed that proceedings will begin with a team from pot one being drawn at random, and they will be allocated eight fixtures – four at home and four away – by an automated software. They will face two teams from each pot, with one home game and one away game per pot, while they cannot play a team from their country.

This will be done for all nine teams from pot one, before the same process takes place for pot two teams, though they will already know their pot one opponents. Pot three teams will then find out their pot three and four opponents, before the pot four sides are allocated their fixtures against each other.

But before the draw we will be hearing from Villa about the 2011 final, which he scored in as Barcelona dismantled Manchester United at Wembley.

He calls it a “great generation” of players, mentioning Lionel Messi, who also scored in the 3-1 win.

Henry will be part of the draw so he remains on stage as Ceferin departs. David Villa will also be coming onto the stage to help with proceedings. We are told the draw will be starting shortly.

We’re hearing from Henry now about losing the 2006 Champions League final with Arsenal and winning three years later with Barcelona.

He’s now discussing the current Arsenal crop and how they are getting closer to the trophy. He says if “they keep their core” and make some additions they can get over the line. But PSG “are an annoying team at the moment”.

Marquinhos on winning the respect award: “I’m very happy and honoured to be given this trophy. Fair play is an essential part of both football and daily life, and I will keep being respectful this year.”.

Sources indicate that up next is the “Uefa President’s Award”? The winner is of course Thierry Henry and, fortunately, he is in attendance, so he’s up on the stage to collect this honour. A slow clap from Martin Keown in the crowd.

Reshmin Chowdhury and Pedro Pinto shuffle the musicians off the stage before outlining this evening’s itinerary.

Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin is then brought up to the stage, after a quiet summer, to announce Marquinhos as the winner of a new award, the Respect Beyond the Game award.

Marquinhos is not at the ceremony, so it will be PSG president Nasser Al-Khelaifi coming up to collect it. We hear from the defender on a video message.

The ceremony is underway in Monaco with a live performance of the famous anthem – orchestra and all – while pictures of previous winners play on the significant screen in the background.

Pot three teams will then find out their pot three and four opponents, before the pot four sides are allocated their fixtures against each other.

There are five English teams involved in the Champions League this season – one short of the Premier League’s tally from last term.

Manchester City, Arsenal and Liverpool will be in pot one, while Manchester United and Aston Villa will be in pot two.

This evening’s ceremony should be getting underway in Monaco in a couple of minutes.

Paris St-Germain will be aiming to become the first team to win three successive Champions Leagues since Real Madrid’s run of titles between 2016 and 2018.

The holders 🔴🔵#UCLdraw pic.twitter.com/eB05BNfWZi.

This season is the third under the new format, with a league phase instead of a group stage, and Uefa has confirmed that fixtures that have taken place in the league phase of the two previous seasons cannot be repeated this time around.

Recent findings suggest that for example, Liverpool cannot host Real Madrid in the league phase this term after welcoming the 15-time European champions to Anfield at this stage of the previous two campaigns. Andoni Iraola’s side could, however, travel to the Bernabeu for an away meeting with Madrid.

Similarly, Arsenal will not be travelling to San Siro to face Inter, but could host the Serie A champions at the Emirates.

Arsenal finished top of the league phase last season after winning all eight fixtures and it resulted in a favourable run to the final, facing Bayer Leverkusen, Sporting and Atletico Madrid.

Liverpool, meanwhile, topped the league phase in the 2024-25 campaign – the first season with the fresh format – but fell at the first hurdle in the knockout stages after being drawn against Paris St-Germain.

The Ligue 1 side have proven that it’s not essential to be firing the whole way through the tournament, finishing 15th and 11th in the league phase in the last two seasons but going on to lift the trophy on both occasions.

Hello and welcome to Telegraph Sport’s live coverage of the Champions League draw in Monaco, with the 36 teams in this season’s competition finding out their eight league phase fixtures.

The teams will be split into four pots of nine, based on “club coefficient rankings”, with defending champions Paris St-Germain automatically named as the top seed.

Liverpool, Manchester City and Arsenal will be among the teams joining the Parisians in pot one, while the two remaining English teams, Manchester United and Aston Villa, will be in pot two.

Proceedings will begin with a team from pot one being drawn at random, and they will be allocated eight fixtures – four at home and four away – by an automated software. They will face two teams from each pot, with one home game and one away game per pot, while they cannot play a team from their country.

In a recent development, this will be done for all nine teams from pot one, before the same process takes place for pot two teams, though they will already know their pot one opponents. Pot three teams will then find out their pot three and four opponents, before the pot four sides are allocated their fixtures against each other.

This season is the third under the newly introduced format, with a league phase instead of a group stage, and Uefa has confirmed that fixtures that have taken place in the league phase of the two previous seasons cannot be repeated this time around.

Industry observers note that for example, Liverpool cannot host Real Madrid in the league phase this term after welcoming the 15-time European champions to Anfield at this stage of the previous two campaigns. Andoni Iraola’s side could, however, travel to the Bernabeu for an away meeting with Madrid.

The league phase will kick off on 8 September and will be wrapped up after all teams play at the same time on 27 January. The top eight teams of the league phase progress to the last 16 automatically, while teams that finish between ninth and 24th will be forced to navigate a play-off tie to reach the knockout stages.

The draw is expected to get underway at 5pm.

Blerim Dzemaili, intervenuto a Radio Tutto Napoli, ha parlato di Dan Ndoye, esterno ora in forza al Nottingham Forest che però in passato è stato vicino all'Inter. Ecco le parole di Dzemaili: "Eravate vicini a uno dei giocatori che a me piacciono di più: Ndoye. Anche l'Inter era vicina. È un giocatore che ti fa spaccare le partite. Però il valore di mercato è altissimo. Una volta che sei in Premier League, anche se valevi 10 milioni, ne vali subito 40, perché in Premier le valutazioni purtroppo sono così. Anche se dovrebbero essere diverse, ma il calcio è così".

According to recent reports, secondo me il Napoli, se deve fare uno o due acquisti, deve sicuramente mettere sul tavolo più soldi del solito. Perché a gennaio, se vuoi davvero dei giocatori forti, devi spendere cifre diverse. Il mercato di gennaio è strano. Non so quanto abbia senso andare a spendere 30 o 40 milioni per un giocatore che magari poi non ti dà quello che ti aspetti e che sopravvaluti anche nell'acquisto, perché alla fine non vale tutti quei soldi. Per me ha più senso se l'allenatore conosce bene un giocatore e dice di volerlo perché può aiutarlo da subito fino a giugno. In quali ruoli ha bisogno il Napoli in questo momento? Penso a un attaccante, sicuramente, ma per me serve anche un leader difensivo che possa gestire tutta la squadra. Un leader difensivo".

Pedro Gonçalves, centrocampista della Fiorentina arrivato in prestito dallo Sporting Club nel corso dell'ultima estate, in un'intervista a Record ha raccontato del suo rapporto con l'ex allenatore Ruben Amorim, oggi tecnico del Milan: "A livello personale mi piaceva molto. Sentivo che avevamo un ottimo rapporto, molto stretto. Spesso lo aiutavo a stemperare la tensione nei momenti di maggiore stress. Mi ha trasmesso un bagaglio calcistico enorme. Gran parte di ciò che so oggi lo devo a lui: i movimenti, il gioco di prima, la capacità di capire quali spazi occupare, e cosi via. Ma su cosa pensi mister Amorim in questo momento, onestamente, non ne ho la minima idea".

Il commento di Gonçalves sulle voci estive di un interessamento proprio del Milan di Ruben Amorim: "Se la possibilità di raggiungere Ruben Amorim mi ha spinto ad aspettare un po' di più prima di decidere del mio futuro? A dire il vero, sì. Ho aspettato un po' più a lungo perché mi era stata prospettata questa eventualità. Ho atteso il tempo necessario, ma alla fine l'opportunità non si è concretizzata. Comunque sono qui alla Fiorentina e, come ho già detto, sono davvero felice".

By LEWIS BROWNING, SPORTS REPORTER.

Published: 14:11 EST, 15 November 2026 | Updated: 21:21 EST, 15 November 2026.

Tenerife have returned to action for the first time since Spanish footballer Jesus de Miguel was tragically killed in a collision during a game with FC Andorra earlier this month.

Goalkeeper Jesus Owono came flying out of his goal and wiped out De Miguel with a high challenge, which resulted in the striker being admitted to intensive care, where he later died.

Thirteen days on from the incident, Tenerife played their first game since the player's death as they took on AD Ceuta CF in LaLiga Hypermotion action – with the game filled with tributes to the star.

Players gave a floral tribute as they arrived for the match, and gathered outside gate nine of the Heliodoro Rodríguez Lopez Stadium – the shirt number he wore.

Grief-stricken Tenerife stars, meanwhile, took to the field carrying a bouquet of flowers, and placed it at the scene of the incident.

Both sets of players and fans then observed a minute's silence in memory of De Miguel before the game kicked off.

🕊️❤️ THE NINTH MINUTE BELONGED TO JESÚS DE MIGUEL! 🥹🏟️ Football took a back seat during Tenerife's first match following his passing.👏 In the ninth minute, the stadium came together in a heartfelt tribute to honor his memory.💔 Some losses are felt far beyond the pitch.… pic.twitter.com/mqPy4aE9Q3.

CF Tenerife returned to action for the first time since the death of Jesus de Miguel in a game flooded with tributes.

Both sets of players gathered around the centre circle before the game to pay tribute.

The forward (pictured in 2025) passed away after being on the receiving end of a brutal tackle.

The game was then brought to a pause in the ninth minute, so the players could pay another tribute.

Fans inside the stadium unveiled a tifo which read: 'Jesus de Miguel, 9, eternal blanquiazul', which translates to: 'Jesus de Miguel, 9, eternally white and blue.'.

Sources indicate that other fans held up white and blue cards beside the tifo, with others in the ground applauding. When Tenerife scored, De Miguel's shirt was held in the air.

After the game, which Tenerife won 2-0, both teams gathered in the centre circle to place De Miguel's shirt on a bouquet of flowers, and the fans applauded to bring an end to an emotional day.

The tragedy occurred as the game against Andorra entered the seventh minute of stoppage time, when De Miguel looked set to race away on the counter-attack for Tenerife in search of a winner.

As he watched a long ball drop into his path, the striker was struck in the chest by Owono's flying knee as he attempted to clear the ball near the halfway line.

After initially rolling around on the floor, De Miguel became motionless, and medical staff rushed onto the pitch to attend to him.

Owono was initially given a red card for the challenge before the decision was soon taken by the referee to abandon the fixture. Fans have chanted 'murderer' in his direction.

Before the game, players gathered outside gate nine - the shirt numebr de Miguel wore.

Goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been handed a 12-match ban and may never play football again.

On Friday, the goalkeeper was hit with a 12-match ban - but may never play again.

His manager Carles Manso has said: 'We will ​give him space so that he feels completely free to make ‌any ⁠decision, whether he wants to return, when, or if he does not want to return.

'When he feels it is appropriate and when ​he feels genuinely ready to take a ​decision ⁠like that (he will do so).'.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Per la trasferta del 28 novembre sono esauriti i 1.489 posti iniziali nel settore ospiti; restano altri tagliandi.

Industry observers note that per Lazio-Lecce sono attese 13.300 presenze all’Olimpico, il secondo dato stagionale più alto per una gara casalinga biancoceleste. Secondo quanto riportato da Il Corriere dello Sport, La vendita dei biglietti avanza lentamente, mentre il tifo organizzato conferma la protesta contro Lotito e la decisione di disertare le partite in casa.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM.

Finora sono stati staccati circa 5.300 biglietti. A questi si aggiungono i 4.500 abbonati stagionali — una cifra non ufficializzata — e i 3.500 sostenitori che hanno aderito al Pack 3. Il totale provvisorio arriva così a 13.300 presenze, secondo quanto riportato dal Corriere dello Sport.

Recent findings suggest that il dato supera le 12.283 presenze registrate nell’ultima gara casalinga contro il Cagliari. Resta alle spalle soltanto delle 21.373 presenze contro il Milan, quando sugli spalti c’erano però circa 10.000 tifosi rossoneri.

It has been revealed that L’affluenza resta lontana dalla normalità descritta per una squadra che guida da sola la classifica. Il tifo organizzato proseguirà infatti la contestazione a Lotito, nonostante i risultati ottenuti dalla formazione di Gattuso.

In a recent development, il clima è diverso in vista del derby del 13 dicembre, indicato come l’unica eccezione alla protesta annunciata prima dell’inizio della stagione. Per la stracittadina sono già garantite 25.500 presenze, con la prospettiva di un Olimpico colorato di biancoceleste.

Recent findings suggest that la risposta alla prevendita è stata immediata nella seconda fase, riservata ai 29.918 abbonati della passata stagione. Il numero delle presenze garantite si avvicina a quella cifra; resta poi la fase aperta a tutti, che potrebbe portare il totale oltre quota 30.000.

Industry observers note that cresce anche l’attesa per la finale di Supercoppa italiana a San Siro. Il 23 novembre si aprirà la finestra di vendita riservata agli abbonati della stagione 2025-26. Al momento possono acquistare i biglietti soltanto gli abbonati al campionato in corso.

#38481. Cherki magic helping Maresca to step out of Guardiola shadow
